list.name: detector
list.label: Detector version
list.query: SELECT v FROM (SELECT 'All' AS v UNION SELECT DISTINCT detector_version FROM detections) t ORDER BY (v <> 'All'), v

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'matched') AS matched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'unmatched') AS unmatched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')

SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'matched') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS match_rate_pct,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.match_distance_m) AS median_distance_m,
       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.match_distance_m) AS p90_distance_m
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')

panels.title: How far the AIS vessel is from the Detection (matched, 50 m buckets)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b::text || '-' || (b + 50)::text AS distance_m, count(*) AS matches
FROM (SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(v.match_distance_m / 50), 9)::int * 50 AS b
  FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'matched') t
GROUP BY b ORDER BY b

panels.title: Outcome by Detection length (300 = 300 m or longer)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(d.length_m, 0) / 50), 6)::int * 50 AS length_from_m,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'matched') AS matched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'unmatched') AS unmatched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(d.confidence * 10), 9)::int / 10.0 AS confidence_from,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'matched') AS matched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'unmatched') AS unmatched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Median match distance by vessel speed (AIS speed over ground)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN ais.sog_knots IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN ais.sog_knots < 3 THEN '0-3 kn'
            WHEN ais.sog_knots < 8 THEN '3-8 kn' WHEN ais.sog_knots < 13 THEN '8-13 kn'
            ELSE '13+ kn' END AS vessel_speed,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.match_distance_m) AS median_distance_m,
       count(*) AS matches
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT a.sog_knots FROM ais_positions a WHERE a.mmsi = v.matched_mmsi
    ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.ts - s.acquired_at))) LIMIT 1
) ais ON true
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'matched'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(COALESCE(ais.sog_knots, -1))

SELECT s.acquired_at, left(s.scene_id, 40) AS scene, count(*) AS detections,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'matched') AS matched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'unmatched') AS unmatched,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.label = 'matched') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS match_rate_pct,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.match_distance_m) AS median_distance_m
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
GROUP BY s.scene_id, s.acquired_at ORDER BY s.acquired_at DESC

panels.title: SAR length against AIS length (matched ships with a known AIS length)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS ships,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.length_m / av.length_m) AS median_sar_over_ais,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY abs(d.length_m - av.length_m)) AS median_error_m,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(d.length_m - av.length_m) <= 0.25 * av.length_m)
         / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS within_25_pct
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
JOIN ais_vessels av ON av.mmsi = v.matched_mmsi
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'matched' AND d.length_m IS NOT NULL AND av.length_m IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Median length by AIS length class: AIS against SAR estimate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN av.length_m < 60 THEN '1: under 60 m' WHEN av.length_m < 120 THEN '2: 60-120 m'
            WHEN av.length_m < 200 THEN '3: 120-200 m' ELSE '4: 200 m or longer' END AS ais_length_class,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY av.length_m) AS ais_length_m,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.length_m) AS sar_length_m
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
JOIN ais_vessels av ON av.mmsi = v.matched_mmsi
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'matched' AND d.length_m IS NOT NULL AND av.length_m IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Matched Detections by distance to the AIS vessel

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ST_Y(d.geom) AS latitude, ST_X(d.geom) AS longitude,
       CASE WHEN v.match_distance_m < 100 THEN 0 WHEN v.match_distance_m < 250 THEN 1
            ELSE 2 END AS class,
       v.match_distance_m, v.matched_mmsi, d.length_m, d.confidence
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'matched'
LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Matches to review: furthest from their AIS vessel first

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '$api_url/v1/detections/' || d.id || '/chip' AS chip, v.matched_mmsi AS mmsi, v.match_distance_m, ais.sog_knots, d.confidence, d.length_m,
       d.shore::text AS shore, s.acquired_at
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT a.sog_knots FROM ais_positions a WHERE a.mmsi = v.matched_mmsi
    ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.ts - s.acquired_at))) LIMIT 1
) ais ON true
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'matched'
ORDER BY v.match_distance_m DESC
LIMIT 40

panels.title: Ambiguous: two AIS tracks inside the gate (strongest first)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '$api_url/v1/detections/' || d.id || '/chip' AS chip, d.confidence, d.length_m, d.shore::text AS shore, s.acquired_at, s.scene_id
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'ambiguous'
ORDER BY d.confidence DESC
LIMIT 40

panels.title: Unmatched: longest first (ships without AIS, or false alarms?)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT '$api_url/v1/detections/' || d.id || '/chip' AS chip, d.confidence, d.length_m, d.shore::text AS shore, s.acquired_at, s.scene_id
FROM validations v
JOIN detections d ON d.id = v.detection_id
JOIN scenes s ON s.scene_id = d.scene_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.acquired_at)
  AND ('$shore' = 'All' OR d.shore::text = '$shore')
  AND ('$detector' = 'All' OR d.detector_version = '$detector')
  AND v.label = 'unmatched'
ORDER BY d.length_m DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 40
